corrections: Restored unchanged canonical maze spacing; this variant changes no map cells.

before: A custom rule in this game is held-key movement. When an arrow key changes from not pressed to pressed, one movement attempt occurs immediately. If the same key remains held, additional movement attempts occur at fixed 0.15-second intervals rather than every frame.
after: A custom rule in this game is held-key movement. When an arrow key changes from not pressed to pressed, one movement attempt occurs immediately. If the same key remains held, additional movement attempts occur at fixed 0.10-second intervals rather than every frame.

before: If the same arrow key remains held, the game waits 0.15 seconds after the initial attempt and then performs additional movement attempts at fixed 0.15-second intervals.
after: If the same arrow key remains held, the game waits 0.10 seconds after the initial attempt and then performs additional movement attempts at fixed 0.10-second intervals.

before: 2. If the same key remains held, subsequent attempts occur every 0.15 seconds.
The 0.15-second interval remains fixed throughout the game and does not change according to remaining Time, Steps, or player position.
after: 2. If the same key remains held, subsequent attempts occur every 0.10 seconds.
The 0.10-second interval remains fixed throughout the game and does not change according to remaining Time, Steps, or player position.

before: The maze layout, total duration of 30 seconds, movement-repeat interval of 0.15 seconds, player starting position, and exit position remain fixed for every run.
after: The maze layout, total duration of 30 seconds, movement-repeat interval of 0.10 seconds, player starting position, and exit position remain fixed for every run.
